sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Syed Ahmed Faizan,Sr. Advocate,Zaheer Asghar

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Vineet Sankalp Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard Shri Syed Farman Ahmad Naqvi, Senior Counsel, assisted by Shri Syed Ahmed Faizan,
Advocate and Shri Zaheer Asghar, Advocate representing the petitioner, Shri M.C. Chaturvedi,
Additional Advocate General, assisted by Shri V.K. Dixit, Additional Chief Standing Counsel representing the State and Shri Vineet Sankalp, Advocate, representing the respondent No. 5.
The present writ petition has been filed for the following reliefs :-
Imamuddin Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145897153/
1

"A. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to refrain from forcing the petitioner to remove, demolish or execute to sign willful agreement to handing over his property CK-69/5 situated in Mohalla Resham Katra City, Varanasi to the respondent Nos. 2, 3 and 4 without adopting to lawful procedure as provided under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to the writ petition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: B. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing and commanding the respondents Nos. 1, 2, 3 and 4 to pass appropriate order upon the application dated 18.5.2025 Annexure-6 to the present writ petition.

C. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing and commanding the respondents be restrained from threatening by visiting the premises of the petitioner and forcing him to demolish his shop no. CK-69/5 situated in Mohalla Resham Katra City, Varanasi voluntarily and handover possession to the respondent authorities."
The factual foundation for the aforesaid reliefs have been noted in paragraph No. 16 and 17 of the writ petition.

Paragraph Nos. 16 and 17 of the writ petition are reproduced below :-
"16.

That, it is further submitted that the respondent authorities are coercing,
threatening and pressurizing the petitioners by informing the petitioners to give away the property and give their consent to the government regarding transfer of land without acquisition.
17.

That, it is further emphatically averred here that the office of Assistant Engineer Regional Zone Public Works Department, Varanasi is forcing the petitioner and other similarly situated persons to leave property stating it to be their own free will on payment of only the damages."

It has been stated by the counsel for the petitioner that the State-respondents intend to dispossess the petitioner and demolish his construction without any acquisition or payment of compensation and are coercing the petitioner to transfer the said property in favour of the State voluntarily through a sale-deed.
In pursuance to the previous order passed by this Court, the Standing Counsel has obtained instructions in the matter.

Shri M.C. Chaturvedi, Additional Advocate General, assisted by Shri V.K. Dixit, Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State submits that the respondents would not disturb the possession of the petitioner and not dispossess him and would also not demolish his construction unless the State acquires title over the property by compulsory acquisition or by any other mode recognized under law.

sentences.text: In view of the statement given by the Additional Advocate General, no purpose would be served to keep the writ petition pending.
The writ petition is disposed of on the assurance given by the Additional Advocate General on behalf of the State.
